# HELP mock_server_llm_cache_hit_ratio Cache-hit ratio (0..1) from the latest LLM optimisation report
# TYPE mock_server_llm_cache_hit_ratio gauge
mock_server_llm_cache_hit_ratio 0.0
# HELP mock_server_llm_chaos_injected_total Action LLM chaos injected count (monotonic counter; use rate()/increase() on this _total series)
# TYPE mock_server_llm_chaos_injected_total counter
mock_server_llm_chaos_injected_total 0.0
# HELP mock_server_llm_cost_budget_tripped_total Total number of times the LLM cost-budget circuit-breaker tripped
# TYPE mock_server_llm_cost_budget_tripped_total counter
mock_server_llm_cost_budget_tripped_total 0.0
# HELP mock_server_llm_cost_usd_total Cumulative estimated LLM cost in USD by provider and model
# TYPE mock_server_llm_cost_usd_total counter
mock_server_llm_cost_usd_total{model="gemini-2.5-flash",provider="gemini"} 3.24E-5
# HELP mock_server_llm_estimated_waste_usd Estimated recoverable LLM spend (USD) from the latest optimisation report
# TYPE mock_server_llm_estimated_waste_usd gauge
mock_server_llm_estimated_waste_usd 0.0

mock_server_llm_input_tokens_total{model="gemini-2.5-flash",provider="gemini"} 8.0
mock_server_llm_input_tokens_total{model="gemini-embedding-001",provider="gemini"} 7.0
mock_server_llm_input_tokens_total{model="text-embedding-005",provider="gemini"} 5.0
# HELP mock_server_llm_one_shot_rate One-shot rate (0..1, fraction of non-retry calls) from the latest LLM optimisation report
# TYPE mock_server_llm_one_shot_rate gauge
mock_server_llm_one_shot_rate 0.0
# HELP mock_server_llm_output_tokens_total Total LLM output tokens by provider and model
# TYPE mock_server_llm_output_tokens_total counter
mock_server_llm_output_tokens_total{model="gemini-2.5-flash",provider="gemini"} 12.0
